# op_item_router (Resource)

Manages a 1Password Router item.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Item title.
- `vault_id` (String) ID of the vault containing the item.

### Optional

- `airport_id` (String) AirPort ID.
- `base_station_name` (String) base station name.
- `base_station_password` (String, Sensitive) base station password.
- `custom_fields` (Attributes List) Custom fields beyond this category's typed fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields))
- `delete_mode` (String) Destroy behavior: `delete` (default) permanently deletes the item, `archive` archives it instead.
- `disk_password` (String, Sensitive) attached storage password.
- `network_name` (String) network name.
- `notes` (String) Item notes (stored as the item's `notesPlain` field).
- `sections` (Attributes List) Item sections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `server` (String) server / IP address.
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.
- `wireless_password` (String, Sensitive) wireless network password.
- `wireless_security` (String) wireless security.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Item ID.
- `version` (Number) Item version.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_fields`

Required:

- `title` (String) Field label.

Optional:

- `address` (Attributes) Address details; required for `Address` fields (the value is derived from these). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields--address))
- `id` (String) Field ID. Set to a built-in field ID (e.g. `username`, `password`) where applicable; otherwise computed.
- `section_id` (String) Section the field belongs to.
- `type` (String) Field type, e.g. `Text`, `Concealed`, `Totp`, `Url`.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field value, treated as sensitive. Constraints: `Date` fields must be `YYYY-MM-DD`; `MonthYear` must be `MM/YYYY`; `Reference` must be a 26-character item ID in the same vault; `SshKey` must be a decrypted PEM private key (one per SshKey-category item); `Totp` accepts an `otpauth://` URI.

Read-Only:

- `ssh_key` (Attributes) SSH key attributes computed by 1Password for `SshKey` fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields--ssh_key))

<a id="nestedatt--custom_fields--address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_fields.address`

Required:

- `city` (String) City.
- `country` (String) Country.
- `street` (String) Street.

Optional:

- `state` (String) State.
- `zip` (String) ZIP / postal code.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_fields--ssh_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_fields.ssh_key`

Read-Only:

- `fingerprint` (String) Key fingerprint.
- `key_type` (String) Key type, e.g. `Ed25519` or `RSA, 4096-bit`.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.



<a id="nestedatt--sections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sections`

Required:

- `title` (String) Section title.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Section ID.
